svg.title: Gridstore layers and region summary scan
svg.desc: Illustrative page with 48 blocks of 128 bytes, nine tracker slots, six stored keys, and six regions of eight blocks. Each region summary stores its maximum, leading, and trailing free run. Adjacent summary windows are scanned in order. Regions two and three provide six contiguous free blocks at offsets 20 through 25. Only the selected mask regions need scanning. Values and occupancy are illustrative.
svg.text: Mask: one bit per block; 1 used, 0 free
Gaps layer: scan adjacent region summaries
Region 2 trailing 4 + region 3 leading 2 fit blocks 20 to 25.
